# 1 Chronicles Chapter 26 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 383v–384r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_026_page_001.jpg, 1CH_026_page_002.jpg

---

**26:1** For-the-divisions of-the-gatekeepers [ha-sho'arim]: to-the-Qorchi — Meshelemyahu son of-Qore, from the-sons of-Asaf. **26:2** And-to-Meshelemyahu [were] sons: Zekharyahu the-firstborn, Yedi'a'el the-second, Zevadyahu the-third, Yatni'el the-fourth, **26:3** Elam the-fifth, Yehochanan the-sixth, Elyo'eynai the-seventh.

**26:4** And-to-Oved-Edom [were] sons: Shemayah the-firstborn, Yehozavad the-second, Yo'ach the-third, and-Sakhar the-fourth, and-Netan'el the-fifth, **26:5** Ammi'el the-sixth, Yissakhar the-seventh, Pe'ulletai the-eighth — for blessed-him God [berakhov elohim].

**26:6** And-to-Shemayah his-son were-born sons, the-rulers [ha-memshallim] of-the-house of-their-father, for mighty-men of-valor [gibborey chayil] [were] they. **26:7** The-sons of-Shemayah: Otni, and-Refa'el, and-Oved, Elzavad — his-brothers [were] sons of-valor [beney chayil] — Elihu and-Semakhyahu. **26:8** All these from-the-sons of-Oved-Edom — they and-their-sons and-their-brothers, men of-ability [ish chayil] with-strength [ba-koach] for-the-service — sixty-two to-Oved-Edom.

**26:9** And-to-Meshelemyahu [were] sons and-brothers, sons of-valor — eighteen. **26:10** And-to-Chosah, from-the-sons of-Merari, [were] sons: Shimri the-head — for not was-he the-firstborn, but-appointed-him his-father as-head — **26:11** Chilqiyyahu the-second, Tevalyahu the-third, Zekharyahu the-fourth. All the-sons and-brothers of-Chosah — thirteen.

**26:12** To-these [were] the-divisions of-the-gatekeepers, to-the-heads of-the-mighty-men [roshey ha-gevarim], duties [mishmarot] corresponding to [le-ummat] their-brothers, to-serve in-the-house of-YHWH. **26:13** And-they-cast lots, the-small as the-great, according-to-the-house of-their-fathers, for-gate and-gate [le-sha'ar va-sha'ar].

**26:14** And-fell the-lot eastward to-Shelemyahu. And-Zekharyahu his-son, a-counselor [yo'ets] with-understanding [be-sekhel], they-cast lots, and-came-out his-lot northward. **26:15** To-Oved-Edom — southward, and-to-his-sons — the-storehouse [beyt ha-asuppim]. **26:16** To-Shuppim and-to-Chosah — westward, with the-gate of-Shallekhet [ha-mashlekheth], on-the-highway [ba-mesillah] the-going-up [ha-olah] — watch [mishmeret] corresponding to [le-ummat] watch.

**26:17** Eastward — the-Levi'im — six; northward — for-the-day — four; southward — for-the-day — four; and-at-the-storehouse — two [and] two. **26:18** At-the-Parbar, westward — four at-the-highway [ha-mesillah], two at-the-Parbar.

**26:19** These [are] the-divisions of-the-gatekeepers, to-the-sons of-the-Qorchi and-to-the-sons of-Merari.

**26:20** And-the-Levi'im — Achiyyah [was] over the-treasuries [otserot] of-the-house of-God [ha-elohim] and-over the-treasuries of-the-holy-things [ha-qodashim]. **26:21** The-sons of-La'dan, the-sons of-the-Gershunni to-La'dan — heads of-the-fathers to-La'dan the-Gershunni — Yechi'eli.

**26:22** The-sons of-Yechi'eli: Zetam and-Yo'el his-brother, over the-treasuries of-the-house of-YHWH. **26:23** To-the-Amrami, to-the-Yitshari, to-the-Chevroni, to-the-Uzzi'eli: **26:24** And-Shevu'el son of-Gershom son of-Mosheh [was] officer [nagid] over the-treasuries. **26:25** And-his-brothers through-El'ezer: Rechavyahu his-son, and-Yeshayahu his-son, and-Yoram his-son, and-Zikhri his-son, and-Shelomit his-son. **26:26** This Shelomit and-his-brothers [were] over all the-treasuries of-the-holy-things which had-consecrated [hiqdish] David the-king, and-the-heads of-the-fathers, and-the-commanders of-thousands and-of-hundreds, and-the-commanders of-the-host [sarey ha-tsava].

**26:27** From the-wars and-from the-spoil [ha-shalal] they-had-consecrated to-strengthen [le-chazzeq] the-house of-YHWH. **26:28** And-all that-had-consecrated Shemu'el the-seer [ha-ro'eh], and-Sha'ul son of-Qish, and-Avner son of-Ner, and-Yo'av son of-Tseruyah — everyone who-consecrated [was] upon the-hand of-Shelomit and-his-brothers.

**26:29** To-the-Yitshari — Kenanyahu and-his-sons, for-the-work [la-melakhah] the-outer [ha-chitsonah] over Yisra'el, as-officers [shoterim] and-as-judges [shophetim]. **26:30** To-the-Chevroni — Chashabyahu and-his-brothers, sons of-valor — one-thousand seven-hundred — over the-oversight [pequddat] of-Yisra'el beyond [me-ever] the-Yarden westward [yam'ah], for-all the-work of-YHWH and-for-the-service of-the-king.

**26:31** To-the-Chevroni — Yeriyyah the-head. To-the-Chevroni, according-to-their-generations for-[their]-fathers — in-the-fortieth year of-the-reign of-David they-were-sought, and-were-found among-them mighty-men of-valor [gibborey chayil] at-Ya'zer of-Gil'ad. **26:32** And-his-brothers, sons of-valor — two-thousand seven-hundred, heads of-the-fathers — and-appointed-them David the-king over the-Re'uveni and-the-Gadi and-the-half tribe of-the-Menashshi, for-every matter of-God and-matter of-the-king.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — ha-sho'arim (the-gatekeepers):** From the root sh-'-r (gate), the gatekeepers (*sho'arim*) were a Levitical guild responsible for security and access control at the temple. The Chronicler treats them as a formal order parallel to priests and musicians.

**v.15 — beyt ha-asuppim (the-storehouse):** Literally "house of the gatherings/collections." This is the storage facility, likely at the southern gate complex. Obed-edom's family guarded both the southern gate and the adjacent storehouse — a position of trust given the temple's wealth.

**v.16 — sha'ar ha-shallekhet:** The "Gate of Casting Out" (*shallekhet*, from the root sh-l-kh, to cast/throw). The name is unique and unexplained — perhaps refuse was cast out here, or it refers to the steep descent. It was on the western side, at the ascending road (*mesillah*).

**v.18 — Parbar:** An obscure term, possibly a colonnade or court on the temple's western side. The word may be of Persian origin. It appears only here and in 2 Kings 23:11.

*— EMET*
